field_principles.status: Records the terminal Exp6546 SMT cost-guard state.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Names the guarded held cost result and exact-completion support.
field_principles.verdict_class: Separates positive, null, partial, blocked, and disqualified cost-guard outcomes.
field_principles.upstream_gate_receipt: Pins Exp6543 by path, hash, expected value, observed value, input hashes, cache, hardware, llama.cpp, budgets, and protected hashes.
field_principles.MODEL_SPECS: Records the three mandated SOTA GGUF hub IDs, local GGUF paths, hashes, quantization, and llama.cpp placement.
field_principles.models_used: Lists the exact mandated hub IDs that supplied inference rows.
field_principles.model_cache_and_load_receipts: Shows cache resolution, GGUF hashes, embedded-tokenizer checks, llama.cpp import, CUDA support, load, smoke, or blocked runtime state.
field_principles.frozen_challenge_contract: Freezes held unit count, domain strata, conflict strata, surfaces, prompt contract, timeout, token accounting, seed, and stop rules before scoring.
field_principles.logical_instance_rows: Stores one logical-instance row with split, domain, fixture identity, constraints hash, exact label, and conflict stratum.
field_principles.proof_preserving_surface_receipts: Shows each surface variant preserves the same logical constraints and exact label.
field_principles.solver_conflict_rows: Records measured Z3 conflicts, decisions, propagations, assertions, quantiles, and replay status.
field_principles.frozen_dispatch_contract: Freezes the train-development-only threshold and exact-tool dispatch rule before held scoring.
field_principles.per_unit_rows: Stores one model-surface-instance-arm row with tokens, time, timeout, parse, exact validity, dispatch, tool time, and charged totals.
field_principles.model_and_surface_effect_rows: Reports surface effects conditional on logical instance and model.
field_principles.conflict_cost_association_rows: Reports conflict-cost association conditional on surface and model without claiming universal model hardness.
field_principles.guarded_versus_unguarded_rows: Reports held guarded cost and exact-completion effects by model family.
field_principles.token_and_time_recomputation: Recomputes prompt tokens, output tokens, tool time, model time, charged time, and charged tokens from rows.
field_principles.exact_completion_receipt: Shows guarded exact completion is non-inferior to unguarded completion before any positive score opens.
field_principles.calibration_rows: Shows threshold fitting used train and development rows only and held rows were unavailable.
field_principles.censoring_and_timeout_receipts: Records timeout, parse-failure, model-failure, checkpoint, and terminal-row coverage.
field_principles.confound_attack_matrix: Attacks prompt-length confounding, surface non-equivalence, cache order, warm-up asymmetry, token mismatch, timer aliases, model substitution, held threshold tuning, tool-time omission, and cherry-picked timeouts.
field_principles.smt_cost_guard_ready_score: Opens only for preregistered held token or time savings with exact-completion non-inferiority across at least two mandated model families and no surface-controlled confound.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Names every failed gate with expected and observed values.
field_principles.aggregate_row_recomputation: Rebuilds the verdict and ready score from gates, rows, costs, exact completion, calibration, censoring, attacks, and protected hashes.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Records paths, hashes, cache, hardware, llama.cpp, solver, budgets, date, seeds, and protected hashes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Shows guarded inputs, specs, prior artifacts, model registry, template, and conductor files stayed byte-identical during the run.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares authenticated local llama.cpp SOTA GGUF inference plus exact Z3 cost guard.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: False because guard value is measured and Z3 is the separate evaluation authority.
field_principles.field_principles: Explains why each required field exists.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each field to specs, inputs, rows, reducers, tests, and hashes.
field_principles.random_seed: Pins challenge selection, surface ordering, dispatch calibration, model seeds, and attack ordering.
field_principles.duration_s: Records measured reducer and live-inference wall time.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Detects drift in gates, models, prompts, rows, costs, attacks, and verdicts.
